name: turbo_c_small
description: Turbo C small memory model; intended for small images/buffers below one 64 KiB data segment
compile_command: tcc -ms -c fax_core.c fax_engine.c fax_g3.c fax_tables.c fax_thread.c fax_default_params.c
notes: Small model uses near data pointers; all image and workspace arrays must fit within the available data segment.
The library sources are compiled as objects; the convenience test driver is intentionally excluded because the runtime workspace size is allocator/application specific.
For full-page fax rasters, use the large/huge-pointer profile and a suitable huge-memory allocator.
The engine performs no heap allocation; the host supplies all workspace arrays.
This profile has not been compiled with Turbo C in the current environment; verify the exact compiler release.
The optimizer and image transforms use C math functions (pow, exp, sqrt, floor, fmod); link the compiler math library/runtime.
The optional fax_image.c host adapter has built-in PGM/BMP readers only unless codec libraries are supplied. Modern PNG/JPEG/TIFF libraries are not part of the Turbo C core-only build.
The optimizer API consumes a caller-owned grayscale raster directly; a DOS host can supply its own file decoder or omit file I/O entirely.
compiler_version_target: Turbo C 2.x/3.x family; confirm exact release
endianness: native compiler target; no byte-order assumptions in the core
